stops.note: Dutch forms of the Germanic name Theodoric, 'ruler of the people'
Thomas Derrick, hangman at Tyburn, beheaded the Earl of Essex in 1601; Essex had earlier spared Derrick from execution for rape
his name passed to the gallows, then to gallows-like lifting cranes, and to the towers over oil wells from the 1860s

current_meaning: a crane for lifting heavy loads; the framework over an oil well
